about: AGENTSPLACE1a2 (the Agents-place design §4): `daoris-driver place … --plan`'s words, case by case, over PlacePlanTests' stand-in world (solo on its own, engine declaring integration, web on github.com with a landing plugin, docs on gitlab.com with none, atlas not adopted with two queued quests). Each case is the verb's words, its exit code and the lines it prints, PLACE_PLAN's plan said in English from the same code.

cases.name: a repository on its own, merged after you accept, with general driving
lines: place: `solo` — Merge after you accept; general driving
`solo`: now Not driven · after Merge after you accept · suggested Merge after you accept
changes, each said once:
`solo`: a tree per session, off → on
`solo`: general driving, off → on
--plan: nothing was written, and nothing was asked.

cases.name: two repositories, a pull request refused where no landing plugin serves the remote
lines: place: `web`, `docs` — A pull request
`web`: now Merge after you accept · after A pull request · suggested A pull request
`docs`: now Merge after you accept · after Merge after you accept · suggested Merge after you accept
changes, each said once:
`web`: how its work lands, merged after you accept → on `feature/{quest}-{slug}`, a pull request by `example.github-pull-request`
refused:
- `docs`'s remote is on `gitlab.com`, and no landing plugin here opens a pull request there: a pull request is its platform's plugin's to open. Add one on Plugins, or choose *A branch to push*.
--plan: nothing was written, and nothing was asked.

cases.name: a repository declaring integration, integrated, with its set-up asked for a library
lines: place: `engine` — Integrated into the line; adoption, for a library or package
`engine`: now Merge after you accept · after Integrated into the line · suggested Integrated into the line
changes, each said once:
`engine`: how its work lands, merged after you accept → on `feature/{quest}-{slug}`, integrated into the line, requested by you
`engine`: a set-up asked of its own session, not asked → asked, for a library or package
declarations:
`engine`: `daoris.gates.json` at `main` `0123456789ab`, blob `fedcba987654`
Accept for integration: the line integrates by this declaration's `integration`, and a changed declaration waits for you while integration goes on under the one last accepted. It is unaccepted now.
{ "gates": [ { "name": "verify", "run": "npm run verify" } ], "integration": {} }
--plan: nothing was written, and nothing was asked.

`atlas`: a set-up asked of its own session, not asked → asked
`atlas`: what starts here while general driving stays off, nothing → its set-up quest alone

cases.name: no --plan is the usage
lines: place: `--plan` is required: this build plans a place's set-up, and applying it is the window's, still to come.
usage: daoris-driver place <repository>… --preset <id> [--with opinion,look,adoption] [--what-it-builds <kind>] [--drive] --plan

cases.name: a rider --with does not take is the usage
lines: place: `opinions` is not something `--with` takes — `opinion`, `look` or `adoption`.
usage: daoris-driver place <repository>… --preset <id> [--with opinion,look,adoption] [--what-it-builds <kind>] [--drive] --plan
